article.title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
article.summary: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership. (Image credit: Allison Joyce)
